svg.aria-label: A world map with nineteen countries filled in. East Asia: Japan, South Korea, China and Taiwan. Southeast Asia: Thailand. West Asia: Israel and the United Arab Emirates. Western Europe: Ireland, France, Germany, Austria and Switzerland. Northern Europe: Denmark, Sweden, Finland and Estonia. North America: Canada and the United States. Oceania: Australia. A green star marks Perth in Western Australia, where I am now.

g.title: Perth, Western Australia. This is where I am.

svg.text: OPEN TO WORK IN · 19 COUNTRIES · 4 CONTINENTS
